ITA-9.4.19 nābhikalpanavidhih नाभिकल्पनविधिः
Cutting the umbilical cord
A standardized technique for cutting the umbilical cord and caring for the umbilical stump.

ITA-9.4.22 nābhinālapatanam नाभिनालपतनम्
Detachmentof umbilical cord
The time at which the dried umbilical cord stump falls off after the fifth day following birth.

nābhibandhanam नाभिबन्धनम्
Fetal attachment of umbilical cord

nābhimaṇḍalam नाभिमण्डलम्
Round area of umbilicus
